room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A mooring post leans into the current.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass. The village goes about its day.
room.village_green.worried: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass. Neighbours talk in low voices about the missing child.
room.village_green.celebration: Lanterns hang from the old elm. The child is home, and the bell still hums over the green.
room.reed_path.title: Reed Path
room.reed_path.description: A narrow path winds south through the reeds toward the fen.
room.reed_path.flooded: Brown water has risen over the reed path since the bell rang.
detail.mud: Soft black mud, churned by boots and birds.
detail.mud.tracks: Among the boot prints, a small bare footprint points toward the fen.
